selection_rationale: All three lemmas were reviewed as C2A class-only entries before the v11 benchmark family and are already admitted by the generic C2A class-past activation architecture. After v15, class-level past authorizes 2sg, 2pl and 3pl only, while the 1pl cell and its documented weak-causative manner alternation remain explicitly deferred. These three pre-v11 lemmas are selected before any external lookup of their 1pl past surfaces.
notes: This file intentionally contains no target surface answers. Its purpose is to create a Git-verifiable pre-answer checkpoint for a narrow C2A 1pl-past experiment. No 1pl past surface for bushi, butaaci or buubi is asserted here.
